nodes.title: The Water Ledger

actions.text: The Water Ledger / Ivo Rook — Someone is buying water for people who no longer exist. Twelve manifests, twelve dead captains, every payment cleared by the same New York office. Rook has been hauling the tanks without asking questions. Last night a girl in the freight queue called him by one of those dead captains’ names. He wants to know who taught her.

The Water Ledger

actions.text: The Water Ledger / Ivo Rook — The manifests are genuine. The names are borrowed. The discrepancy is not where the water went; it is who sold the district’s right to buy it.

actions.text: The Orchard That Remembers / Dr. Mara Sol — A grove on TRAPPIST-1 e has grown around a survey stake placed only six days ago. The tree rings say forty years. Mara does not believe in prophetic trees. She does believe that someone has changed the dating standard—and that the colony’s food contracts were priced using the old one.

The voice knows a childhood song that was never broadcast off Earth.
